about: A giant shark of the open sea; heard as surges of water and the crunch of its jaws.
notes: v1 brief for the torch backend (MOSS-SoundEffect v2.0 on CUDA). Each prompt asks for several events with pauses in one 8 s file, and the picker cuts the best of them. Slots with loop: true are beds: the picker cuts a seamless stretch.

prompts.text: Underwater: a giant shark swims past, a deep surging whoosh of water and a low rumble, three separate passes with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
Underwater: a giant shark thrashes suddenly, a violent churning surge of water, three separate times with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
Underwater: a giant shark is struck and thrashes, muffled churning water, three separate times with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
Underwater: a giant shark's thrashing slows and fades into stillness, one time. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A giant shark bites: a huge crunching snap of jaws and churning splash, four separate bites with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
Underwater: a large fish tail sweeps the water, soft deep swooshes, several separate strokes. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
